title: EM Assets Find Relief as US Jobs Data Eases Rate Fears
summary: An index tracking emerging-market currencies climbed to a session high after weaker-than-expected US jobs data prompted traders to scale back bets on another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike this month. Nonfarm payrolls increased by 29,000 in September after downward revisions to the prior two months, according to Bureau of Labor Statistics data released Friday. The figure missed all estimates in a Bloomberg survey of economists. For more, we speak with Anisha Goodly, Fixed Income Managing Director at TCW. (Source: Bloomberg)
excerpt: Nonfarm payrolls increased by 29,000 in September after downward revisions to the prior two months, according to Bureau of Labor Statistics data released Friday.
translation: 美国劳工统计局周五公布的数据显示，9 月非农就业人数增加 29,000，此前两个月的数据被下修。

title: Traders now see little chance of a Fed rate hike in October after weak jobs report
summary: Odds tumbled after a jobs report showed a soft labor market, leading more traders to lower the the chances of a fed funds rate increase this month.
excerpt: Traders now see little chance of a Fed rate hike in October after weak jobs report
translation: 疲弱的就业报告公布后，交易员目前认为美联储 10 月加息的可能性很小

title: Oil prices lower as G7 nations to release diesel stocks, Saudis reportedly plan attack on Houthis
summary: The G7 will deploy 100 million barrels of reserves over the next four months, the group's leaders said in a joint statement.

title: G7 nations to release diesel stocks as wars in Europe and Middle East constrain fuel supplies
summary: EU countries are set for crisis talks on soaring diesel prices, with officials warning a U.S. export ban could hurt Europe’s economic outlook.
